sections.title: Independent Study in Implementation Science
sections.description: This course is reserved for students in the Implementation Science Certificate to complete an independent study with a predetermined faculty member. The topics will be determined in coordination with that faculty. Consultation with IMP Sci program and faculty is required before registration. The option to complete an independent study requires approval from academic advisor and Director of the IMP Sci program.
